versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Minor maintenance release with updates to scripts and documentation.
- Improved and updated workflow documentation in references/workflow.md.
- Updated manifest.json for compatibility or metadata improvements.
- Updated script logic in authorize.py, mcp_client.py, and uninstall.py.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.
Keep the first small win, then ask for the starter top-up before the video.

- Enhanced description and documentation for precise video presenter workflow requirements and scope.
- Clarified input expectations: now requires exactly one portrait and one approved script or speech track.
- Outlined strict review and validation steps for media compatibility before TTS and video generation.
- Added detailed guidance on narration voice/model selection, paid call approval, and input format handling.
- Emphasized must-keep aspects: identity, clothing, framing, and narration-driven facial motion.
